name: Talondeep Vale
summary: In south-central Ashenvale, the wooded vale carries travelers toward the Stonetalon Mountains.

sections.title: A Sheltered Valley
sections.body: Talondeep Vale lies beneath Ashenvale’s trees. Silverwind Refuge stands to the east, with the Ruins of Stardust nearby. To the south, the land rises toward the Stonetalon Mountains. Travelers cross the valley between Ashenvale’s heart and the high crags beyond.

faq.answer: Talondeep Vale lies in south-central Ashenvale, between Silverwind Refuge, the Ruins of Stardust, and the southern pass into the Stonetalon Mountains.

faq.q: Where does the path leading south through the vale go?
faq.answer: The trail through Talondeep Vale leads to Talondeep Path. It climbs through rugged heights between Ashenvale’s woodlands and the arid peaks of the Stonetalon Mountains.

faq.q: What nearby landmarks should travelers watch for?
faq.answer: Silverwind Refuge lies to the east, and the Ruins of Stardust stand nearby beneath the trees.

angles.text: As a night elf, you know the paths near Mystral Lake and the Ruins of Stardust. They are familiar ground in southern Ashenvale.
